activity.notes: Bill Clinton served as the 42nd President of the United States for two terms, from his first inauguration on 20 January 1993 through 20 January 2001.

sources.title: William J. Clinton Presidential Library and Museum
sources.citation_text: The Clinton Presidential Library states that Bill Clinton served as the 42nd President of the United States from 1993 until 2001.

sources.title: Permanent Exhibits - The Inauguration
sources.citation_text: The Clinton Presidential Library records that President Clinton was inaugurated on January 20, 1993.

sources.title: President Bill Clinton Photo Gallery
sources.citation_text: The Clinton Presidential Library identifies January 20, 2001 as Clinton's final day as President.
